pull.title: node: move index ownership to NodeContext
pull.body:
This removes the remaining process-global index ownership and stores node-owned indexes in `NodeContext` instead.

Indexes moved:

- `g_txindex`
- `g_txospenderindex`
- `g_coin_stats_index`
- `g_filter_indexes`

`NodeContext` now owns these index instances, while `node.indexes` remains a non-owning list used for common index startup, shutdown, and `getindexinfo` handling.

Behavior should be unchanged, apart from the key order in `getindexinfo` output. Indexes are still created from the same startup options, started in the same init step, stopped before destruction, and destroyed while `validation_signals` is still alive so they can unregister safely.

The block filter index registry is moved to `node/indexes.{h,cpp}` so `index/` code does not depend on `NodeContext`. `PeerManager` receives a small lookup callback instead of reaching into global state.

Review notes:
- The first four commits are small and mostly mechanical: move `txindex`, `txospenderindex`, and `coinstatsindex` ownership to `NodeContext`, then make `getindexinfo` use `node.indexes`. The first commit also adds custom deleters in `node/indexes.cpp`, so `node/context.cpp` does not include index headers, which would create circular dependencies.
- The fifth commit adds a block filter index lookup callback to `PeerManager::Options`, still backed by the global registry.
- The last commit is the main one to review carefully. It moves block filter index ownership to `NodeContext`, moves the block filter registry to `node/indexes.{h,cpp}`, and points the `PeerManager` lookup at `NodeContext` instead of global state.

https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/24230 still keeps process-global index ownership.

So this PR is mostly orthogonal to it: #24230 changes how indexes sync with the chain and removes index dependencies on node internals, while this PR moves index ownership into `NodeContext`.

There is no conceptual conflict.
In terms of code there will be rebase conflicts after one or the other lands, since both touch the index/init/RPC/REST paths. 

Removing process-global index ownership seems aligned with the multiprocess direction anyway.
Ping for rebase @w0xlt. I'm still interested in the change.

events.message:
node: move txindex ownership to NodeContext

Replace the g_txindex global with NodeContext::txindex and pass the
index to GetTransaction() explicitly instead of reading the global.

Index types are destroyed through deleters defined in node/indexes.cpp
because including index headers in node/context.cpp would create
circular dependencies (index/base.cpp includes node/context.h). These
can become plain unique_ptrs once index code no longer depends on
NodeContext.
node: move txospenderindex ownership to NodeContext
node: move coinstatsindex ownership to NodeContext

rpc: get index info from NodeContext indexes

getindexinfo now iterates NodeContext::indexes instead of querying each
index type separately. The set of reported indexes is unchanged, but
when several indexes are enabled the keys in the result follow the
order in which the indexes are registered at startup.

net_processing: get block filter index via PeerManager::Options

Add a get_block_filter_index callback to PeerManager::Options and use it
instead of calling the global GetBlockFilterIndex() directly. Callers
still pass the global lookup, so behavior is unchanged.

This lets the next commit move block filter index ownership without
net_processing depending on NodeContext.

events.body: Rebased on master. Thanks @sedited for the ping.

comments.body: Are the custom deleters really needed? `NodeContext` already handles this for its other `unique_ptr` members via the destructor here: https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/ed7dd7cf4e1561a97edf72eba29a67b14e28c717/src/node/context.h#L95 Since `node/context.cpp` and `index/*.cpp` are both in bitcoin_node, I think you could just add the index includes there and use plain `std::unique_ptr<TxIndex>` etc.

Thanks! Plain `unique_ptrs` would compile, but `index/base.cpp` includes `node/context.h`, so including the index headers in `node/context.cpp` introduces new circular dependencies:

```txt
index/base -> node/context -> index/blockfilterindex -> index/base
index/base -> node/context -> index/coinstatsindex -> index/base
index/base -> node/context -> index/txindex -> index/base
index/base -> node/context -> index/txospenderindex -> index/base
```

The deleters are defined in `node/indexes.cpp` to avoid that.

They can be dropped in a follow-up once `index/base.cpp` no longer needs `node/context.h`. 
#24230 already removes most of that dependency, leaving only the `AbortNode()` call in `FatalErrorf()`. Replacing that with a `Chain` method would allow plain unique_ptrs here and also remove the existing `index/base` -> `node/context` -> `net_processing` -> ... lint exception.

If you'd rather add these to `EXPECTED_CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCIES` for now, I'm happy to switch to plain unique_ptrs.

I've updated the code comment and commit message to make the reason clearer.
